info.title: Kiorex API
info.description: Kiorex marketplace API. Identity: Kiorex Passport (OIDC). Errors: { code, message, ...extra }. Flag OFF => 403 FEATURE_DISABLED {key, scope}.

recipientMasked.description: Masked recipient; raw recipients never leave the dev inbox

replies.description: Messages the platform sent in reaction to this inbound message

state.description: LIVE or the reason it is not (AWAITING_GATE, OFF_GLOBAL, ...)

apiEndpoint.description: Regional API base for this market (binding), with /api/v1

resolvedMarket.description: The link or account market when LIVE, else the default. Never derived from IP or device location.

showMarketSelector.description: False unless more than one market is live (founder rule 23 Nov 2026).

proposedDefault.description: true while the value is the in-code PROPOSED_DEFAULT (founder-delegated 23 Nov 2026), i.e. no override stored

scopeId.description: MARKET: ISO country code; ORG: partner / clinic organisation id; GLOBAL: omit

value.description: Validated against the policy definition (e.g. { enabled, percentBps, capMajor })

props.description: Only these keys are accepted: specialtyCode, providerId, market, code, district, careType, serviceLocation. Values: specialty code, id, ISO market, SCREAMING_SNAKE code. Anything else is a 400.

signature.description: base64url HMAC-SHA256 over the sorted-key JSON of the snapshot without this field

flags.description: Map of Kiorex flag key -> effective state (hide entry points when enabled=false)

blockedBy.description: DEPENDENCY: the flag that is OFF

gate.description: Launch-gate evidence recorded by a human; null until then (first row when several gates are required)

gateIds.description: Gate ids that must ALL have evidence (e.g. GHV1, GHV2); empty = any single evidence row

edition.description: NURSE for nurse.* keys (served in the kiorly-clinic snapshot)

gates.description: Every gate evidence row recorded for this flag

missingGates.description: Launch-locked flags: gate ids still without evidence (ANY when no gate id is listed and none recorded)

orgRef.description: Organisation reference (the id used by ORG-scope flags and commissions)

releaseCohort.description: Lower-case release cohort token, e.g. pilot or ga

evidence.description: Evidence recorded by a human for this flag + gate; null until then

nationalIdLast4.description: National ID is never returned; last 4 digits only

expiresAt.description: Age of majority: guardian access ends

bookings.description: Contributed by other modules (bookings, vault, pharmacyOrders, labBookings ...)

confirmed.description: Confirmed with the OTP-verified phone (needed once before the first home booking)

summary.description: Masked one-line summary (label · district · governorate), safe to show anywhere

serviceLocation.description: Rev 2.3: where this slot takes place

district.description: Rev 2.3: district code of a HOME slot

enabled.description: Provider offers home visits AND kiorex.home_visits is effective

homeSurchargeMinor.description: Home surcharge (BR56, separate invoice line, outside S and C); null when not a home provider

visitFeeIncludingSurchargeMinor.description: Visit fee incl. home surcharge (KXMHV04) when searching at HOME

latitude.description: Clinic latitude for the results map; omitted for home-only providers (never a personal address)

longitude.description: Clinic longitude for the results map; omitted for home-only providers

bookable.description: false when kiorex.marketplace is OFF: show clinicPhone instead

assignsClinician.description: Agencies: the agency assigns a clinician after booking (HOME_VISIT_ASSIGNED)

defaultServiceLocation.description: Location the defaultTypeId / nextSlots belong to

emergency.description: Present for emergency language: show 123 guidance, never booking

marketsLive.description: Only present (empty) when no market is live

homeSurchargeMinor.description: Home surcharge included in totalMinor (BR56); 0 for in-clinic fees

totalMinor.description: amountMinor + homeSurchargeMinor: the visit fee shown to the patient (KXMHV04)

patientCancelMinHours.description: Hours before the visit a patient may still cancel

depositRefundMinHours.description: Deposit is refunded when cancelled at least this many hours ahead

coverageDistricts.description: Coverage DISTRICT codes only (KXMDS05); never a home address

verificationRegister.description: Register that verified the clinician, e.g. a syndicate register

categoryEnabled.description: false when the care-type category flag is OFF/awaiting its gate: the profile stays readable, new bookings are 403

assignsClinician.description: KXMPR02 agency profile: the agency assigns a clinician after booking

homeVisit.description: "Visits at home in" districts and the home surcharge (KXMPR01)

district.description: District code the HOME slots were searched for

enabled.description: false while the category flag is OFF or awaiting its launch gate

kind.description: Notification kind, e.g. BOOKING_CONFIRMED, REMINDER_24H, WAITLIST_OFFER, FOLLOW_UP_DUE, RECORD_SHARED

checkoutUrl.description: Hosted checkout URL while the payment is open

minutes.description: Coarse arrival estimate, only when the provider shares it (KXMHV06)

visitFeeMinor.description: Visit fee without the home surcharge

homeSurchargeMinor.description: Home surcharge (BR56): provider patient revenue on a separate invoice line; never enters S or C

depositRequired.description: Deposit required (BR54 default for home visits when an amount is configured)

noShow.description: always false: an unsafe abort is never a no-show (BR61)

depositUnderReview.description: The deposit is held for ops review, never auto-forfeited (KXMPAY07)

masked.description: true 24 h after the visit (KXMHV10): doorstep lines are no longer returned

address.description: Doorstep lines of the booking snapshot; null once masked

subState.description: Home sub-state (main status stays in the KX-03 §05 machine)

steps.description: Confirmed → On the way → Arrived → Finished (KXMHV06)

trackingEnabled.description: kiorex.visit_tracking effective: on-the-way updates and the estimate are shown

assignee.description: Agency bookings: assigned nurse name, photo, badge once HOME_VISIT_ASSIGNED arrives (KXMHV05). Never a phone number

assignmentPending.description: Agency listing: waiting for the agency to assign a clinician

sessionId.description: Clinic TelehealthSession id (the Clinic owns the call; Kiorex stores the id only)

state.description: IN_PERSON = the visit was changed to an in-person visit

joinUrl.description: Patient join page on the Clinic (https://.../v/<token>). Null once the visit can no longer be joined. Open it in the browser, or in a WebView with camera/microphone permission in the app.

opensAt.description: Join window opens (Clinic value, else 15 min before the booking time)

closesAt.description: Join window closes (Clinic value, else 2 h after the booking time)

movedFrom.description: Previous start time when the visit was moved

id.description: Kiorex booking id; also the Kiorly Idempotency-Key / externalReference

cancellationPolicy.description: Kiorly cancellation policy as published on the listing

visitDistrict.description: District code only (KXMHV03: the address itself is under the patient)

feeMinor.description: Visit fee (home surcharge is separate, see home.fee)

amountMinor.description: The CARD amount to pay now (the deposit minus any credit applied)

rewardMinor.description: GRW-P2-B2: credit (coupon or patient credit) applied to this deposit, in minor units; absent when none

couponProblem.description: GRW-P2-B2: why a coupon was not applied (COUPON_INVALID, NOT_APPLICABLE); the same text for a wrong code and for a code of another account
